CONTRACT AWARD NOTICE
Reference: OGP-2024-FM-0042

Contracting Authority: Office of Public Works, Dublin, Ireland

Contract Title: Provision of Integrated Facilities Management Services — Government Buildings Portfolio

Description: The provision of total facilities management services including cleaning, janitorial, grounds maintenance, M&E maintenance (HVAC, mechanical, electrical), waste management, pest control and security services across 42 government buildings in the greater Dublin and Leinster regions.

Award Date: 14 March 2024

Value: EUR 8,500,000

Awarded to: CleanCore Facilities Ltd

Contract Duration: 3 years with option to extend by 2 x 12 months.

Evaluation Criteria:
- Price: 40%
- Methodology: 30%
- Environmental Plan: 20%
- Local Industry Participation: 10%

Contracting Authority Contact: procurement@opw.gov.ie
